answer: To register, an agent relays proof through a cross-chain bridge that checks the relic was never reused elsewhere. Agents must stake a unique sable token locked to a verified hardware relic, a one-per-device attestation key burned at registration. Duplicate identities require buying a fresh relic and sable stake, making each fake agent cost real capital plus a scarce device signature. Sybil farming collapses because attackers pay full price per reputation slot with no bulk discount. In practice, qwe0002 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
